_README: Suburbs a stock document cannot state for itself, checked by hand against the developer's own published address. Each rule may match four ways, most precise first: `url` is the exact source_url; `folder` is the Dropbox shared-folder id (the path segment after /scl/fo/) the price list sits in; `project` is a lowercase substring tested against the row's builder_name and estate_name; `title` is a lowercase substring tested against the document's own front page. url alone is NOT enough -- builders re-upload price lists to fresh links and the rows follow the new URL, so a url-only rule silently stops applying and those listings go back to having no suburb. A re-upload can rename the file too (22 Sep 2026: 'VandA Pricelist' became 'Victoria & Albert - Sales List', so builder_name changed and 'vanda' stopped matching 114 rows); the folder stayed the same, which is why Dropbox rules carry `folder`. A matching rule here outranks the automatic front-page map (document_suburbs.json). Keep `evidence` filled in: it is what lets the next person re-check the claim instead of trusting it.

rules.evidence: Victoria & Albert, 20 Albert Ave Broadbeach QLD 4218. The folder holds both uploads seen so far: 'VandA Pricelist (2) (1).pdf' and 'Victoria & Albert - Sales List - 22 Sep 2026 4.55pm.pdf'.

Same development as the 'vanda' rule above: Victoria & Albert, 20 Albert Avenue, Broadbeach QLD 4218 (apartments.com.au; dbi.com.au 'Albert Avenue, Broadbeach'). The 22 Sep 2026 re-upload is stored as builder 'Victoria & Albert 22 20 Pm', which 'vanda' never matched -- 114 apartments lost their suburb. This is the project's own name, for a re-upload that lands outside the known folder.

The Fawkner, Fawkner Park / St Kilda Road, Melbourne VIC 3004 - the tower fronts St Kilda Road; 'Fawkner Park West' is the release name, and Fawkner itself is a suburb 15 km north that this project has nothing to do with

The Millwell, 2 Millwell Road East, Maroochydore QLD 4558 (Habitat Development Group). Millwell Road is in Maroochydore, not Morayfield. 7 Oct 2026: the same folder now also holds 'MasterPriceList (1) Millwill MD.pdf' -- the builder's misspelling, stored as builder 'Millwill Md', which 'millwell' does not match (44 rows had no suburb). Its rows read 'The Millwell: Tower 1 1104 ...', and apartments.com.au/new-apartments/the-millwell-2-millwell-road-east-maroochydore-qld-4558 lists The Millwell as two eight-level towers at 2 Millwell Road East, Maroochydore.
Aston Junction, 493 Mountain Highway, Bayswater VIC 3153 - industrial unit development. Bayswater also exists in WA, so the state is pinned here

Danks St District, 903-921 Bourke Street, Waterloo NSW 2017 (DASCO). The price list's own header reads 'Danks St. District - [Bourke St Residences]', which is why an earlier filename rule tried to call it Bourke -- a NSW town 760 km west

St Clair, 11 Waterside Retreat, Birtinya QLD 4575 (Habitat Development Group) - two towers on Lake Kawana, which is why the rows read 'Lake View'. Not St Clair NSW or St Clair SA, both of which are localities

Stockland's Kings Forest, an 869-hectare masterplanned community on the Tweed Coast in the Tweed Shire, NSW, adjacent to Casuarina and near Kingscliff. Kings Forest is a locality in NSW and nowhere else. The ten rows record QLD and their state_source reads 'e-agent page' - the state was taken from the page the flyer was listed on, not the property, and four are already flagged 'conflicting signals'

Solara Kings Beach, 19-21 Verney Street, Kings Beach QLD 4551 (Citimax). apartments.com.au lists 7 floors, 23 residences, apartments AND skyhomes, three and four bedroom - the price list has exactly that shape: lots 01-22, Skyhome from level 6, 3-4 bed. The document itself names no locality anywhere in its full text.

The Highgate, Dornoch Terrace, Highgate Hill QLD 4101 (Pointcorp) - a 10-storey apartment building, matching the price list's Level / Apt # / Aspect / Body Corp columns. Every QLD development named Highgate is in Highgate Hill; there is no other QLD locality called Highgate.

Yarra Park Townhomes Stage 1, 65 Parkview Road, Alphington VIC 3078 (U-Home Oceania, Rothelowman). Corroborated inside this catalogue: the separate Parkview Properties price list already resolves to Alphington off its own address.
KNEW, 82 New Street, South Kingsville VIC 3015 (Frater Group, IN8 Architects) - 32 townhouses in two, three and four bedroom configurations; the price list carries 4/3.5/2 types.

Port Lane, 201 Williamstown Road, Port Melbourne VIC 3207 (ID_Land, Rothelowman). Decisive: 'Sea Breeze' is one of Port Lane's six named floorplans - 3 bed, 2 bath, 2 car - and appears verbatim in this stock list's rows.

The document says so itself, in a Comments column the extractor does not read: 'Large Terrace design with own street access. Fronting Greensill Rd' and 'looking over parkland area towards Creek'. Greensill Road is in Albany Creek QLD 4035, which also carries townhouse developments of this type.
The project names its own town: 'Canvas Cooroy'. Cooroy is a QLD locality (Noosa hinterland, 4563) and the rows record QLD. The price list itself names no locality anywhere in its text.

Imperial Square by Azzura, 59-73 Meron Street, Southport QLD 4215. 'Regal Azzura Luxury Apartments' and 'Regal Residences' are the same development - both price lists sit in one Dropbox folder (rlkey f0c1qw0raf...), which is what suggested they were one project before the address confirmed it.
Imperial Square by Azzura, 59-73 Meron Street, Southport QLD 4215. Same development and same folder as the Regal Azzura price list.
UNIQ, 2-4 Waterford Court, Bundall QLD 4217 (DevLink Group), 22 townhomes with self-contained multi-purpose rooms - the price list's rows read '3 bed plus MPR Tandem'.

The email subject names it: 'Fw: $989K - REGISTERED SECONDARY DWELLING - COLLINGWOOD PARK'. Collingwood Park is a locality in QLD and in WA, which is why the subject reader refuses it on its own. The row's address settles it: Cypress Street is a real street in Collingwood Park QLD 4301, and 7000 Cypress St there was a 32-lot residential subdivision sold in March 2026 - new dual-occupancy stock at $989K. Collingwood Park WA is a rural locality near Albany with no such street.

rules.evidence: The row's own text reads '99 Woodchester Gatton Cooper D 203' - Woodchester is the estate and Gatton the town, and 15 other rows in this catalogue carrying the same text resolve to Gatton QLD. It is refused automatically because Woodchester is ALSO a locality in South Australia, so the row's text names one place in QLD and another in SA and the reader will not choose between them. Scope note: this is keyed to one dated round-up email; if that subject ever carries a second project the rule would be wrong for it.

rules.evidence: ARCA Stafford, 1 Theodore Street, Stafford QLD 4053 (apartments.com.au). The sheet's 'Theodore' is the STREET the building stands on, not a suburb - there is also a town called Theodore 500 km north west, which is what the column looked like.
Millfield Rise, 1721 Mount View Road, Millfield NSW - a 217-lot estate on the outskirts of Cessnock (Newcastle Herald).

Suncourt Residences, 70-76 Omrah Avenue, Caloundra QLD 4551 - 77 residences across 4 buildings (apartments.com.au/new-apartments/suncourt-residences-70-76-omrah-avenue-caloundra-qld-4551); the price list ('Suncourt Residences - Sales List - 22 Sep 2026') has exactly 77 lots, A-201 onward. 671 Chapel Street, South Yarra VIC 3141 (Kapitol Group; apartments.com.au/new-apartments/671-chapel-street-south-yarra and urban.com.au/new-apartments/671-chapel-street-south-yarra), 'where the Yarra River meets South Yarra's Domain precinct'. The price list is 'Pricelist New Agent.pdf', so its rows carry builder 'Agent' and no usable project name (hence no project key); the same Dropbox folder holds '671 Chapel Street - 1 Bedroom - Options Price List.pdf' and '671 Chapel Street - 2 Bedroom - Options Price List.pdf' (nightly log 6 Oct 2026), and the rows' own aspect column reads 'NE-Chapel St', 'NE-river' and 'SW-city views'.

The price list names its own suburb: it is 'Price Kew.pdf', listed on E-Agent's VIC apartments page (Kew is also a NSW town; VIC settles it). The building matches Piccolo House, 18 Barry Street, Kew VIC 3101 (apartments.com.au Kew listings; urban.com.au 'First look exclusive: Piccolo plot new Kew apartment development'): five three-level buildings, 60 two- to four-bedroom apartments, optional den layouts, a subterranean wine cellar, from $2,200,000. The rows are levels G, 1 and 2 only, 2-3 bed with 'Den' and 'Cellar', cheapest $2,200,000. The builder name is blank and the estate column holds headings ('Car Storage Cage'), hence no project key.

Babylon by Denvell Group, 41 Terry Road, Rouse Hill NSW 2155 (apartments.com.au/buildings/babylon-41-terry-road-rouse-hill-nsw-2155). apartments.com.au news 'From Hanging Gardens inspiration to 364 homes: Babylon completes in Rouse Hill': one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments alongside terraces and townhomes, 'between $560,000 and $1.025 million'. The price list ('Price Babylon.pdf') carries 33 APT and TH lots at $570,000-$920,000 (corrected 7 Oct 2026, repair round 2: the range was misquoted).

Regatta at Collins Wharf (Lendlease), 951 Collins St, Docklands VIC 3008 (hickory.com.au/project/regatta: '951 Collins St, Docklands, Victoria 3008', 317 waterfront apartments, townhomes and skyhomes; urban.com.au 'Regatta at Collins Wharf, Docklands, 951 Collins Street'). The rows themselves say 'Riverhome', 'Completing in 2027 (est.) with Ancora' and 'Contract is under CW3' (Collins Wharf stage 3); Ancora's own rule above is Docklands too.

The Foundry, 22 W.M Hughes St, North Ipswich QLD 4305 - 28 three- and four-bedroom terrace homes in a gated community (capitalpropertyfunds.com.au/cpf-property-debt-fund-offers-the-foundry-ipswich-second-mortgage). Independently, the nightly front-page read of this price list named North Ipswich (6 Oct 2026 log: '18 rows -> North Ipswich (QLD) The_Foundry_StockList_2026-09-18'). No project key on purpose: 'The Foundry' is also a 16-hectare precinct in Runcorn, Brisbane, so the name alone would misplace a future Runcorn list.

'95SKR' is 95 St Kilda Road: Fareham by Gamuda Land, 95 St Kilda Road, St Kilda VIC 3182 (apartments.com.au/new-apartments/fareham-95-st-kilda-road-st-kilda: 2 and 3 bed, from $975,000; apartments.com.au news 'Gamuda Land get sign off for St Kilda apartment development, Fareham': '95 St Kilda Road, St Kilda VIC 3182'). The list's 2-3 bed lots run L3-L13 and its cheapest is $975,000, the published from-price. The nightly front-page read named this list 'Waterways' (6 Oct 2026 log), which is wrong -- Waterways is about 20 km south-east -- and this rule outranks it.

A 30-townhouse project at 65 Timor Avenue, Loganholme QLD 4129 (apartments.com.au/new-townhouses/65-timor-avenue-loganholme-qld-4129) - 'Timor Residences' is named for its street, and the list is 3-bed townhouses. Independently, the nightly front-page read of the price list itself named Loganholme (6 Oct 2026 log: '9 rows -> Loganholme (QLD) Timor_Residences_StockList_2026-09-22').

Prince & Parade by Mirvac, 701 Park Street, Brunswick VIC 3056 (apartments.com.au news 'Display Suite Tour Video: Prince & Parade by Mirvac 701 Park Street, Brunswick'; urban.com.au 'Mirvac reveal latest Melbourne apartment development, Prince & Parade Brunswick'): one- to four-bedroom apartments opposite Princes Park, interior palettes 'Sanctuary' and 'Celestial'. The price list ('18032026 - Prince  Parade Agent Price List.pdf') runs 1B1B to 4B3B and its rows name the 'Sanctuary' scheme. Brunswick is also a WA locality; VIC pins it.

Westwood estate, 235 Beattys Road, Fraser Rise VIC 3336 - townhomes (apartments.com.au/new-townhouses/westwood-235-beattys-road-fraser-rise-vic-3336; Dahua's Westwood, Fraser Rise). The rows' own text names it too: 'AvailableFraserRise Q4 Townhouse 1053 ...' -- glued to 'Available', which is why the reader misses it.
